snippet.title: Tempest Rising - The Veti's Wrath Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the final chapter of Tempest Rising: lead the shattered Veti through a full-fledged 11-mission campaign to reunite your forces, reclaim stolen technology, and excise the corruption threatening to subsume your people from within.

The Veti's Wrath Expansion is releasing later this year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4114220/Tempest_Rising_The_Vetis_Wrath/
